title: Simplify project bootstrap and template flows
summary: Reduce complexity in project resolution, bootstrap/setup, template generation, and local git/file helpers while preserving bootstrap output.

goal.outcome: Project/bootstrap/template code has clearer helper boundaries and lower complexity without changing starter output or project resolution behavior.
acceptance: Project root/config resolution, bootstrap/setup orchestration, starter template rendering, and local git/file helpers have focused helper boundaries where practical.
Long parameter lists in template helpers are replaced with options objects when it improves clarity.
Bootstrap starter output and package smoke behavior remain compatible.
Complexity review improves for project/context, project/bootstrap, project/templates, and project/root/git-cache hotspots.
non_goals: Do not change starter taxonomy semantics.
Do not move project ownership out of src/project/**.
Do not alter Pi package install behavior.
verification: rerun complexity review for project files

delta.desired: Project support flows are easier to maintain with unchanged outputs.
delta.current: Project/bootstrap/template files appear in complexity and long-parameter review findings.
delta.closure: Task closes when project tests pass and review metrics improve for targeted project files.
